Subject: RE: Optimizer savings qualification & quantization recommendations — SE technical note + pilot playbook

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the details. Short technical guidance below and attached a concise playbook (optimizer_playbook_v2.pdf) + draft SOW. TL;DR: you can expect meaningful token-cost reduction with an INT8-first strategy plus KV prefix caching for the chat flows; we recommend a small eval to validate quality delta.

Technical recommendations (summary):
1) Quantization:
  - Generation models (horizon-instruct-v1): ship an INT8 runtime variant for inference. INT8 preserves throughput and reduces GPU memory — recommended for steady-state.
  - Sensitive batches (PHI subset): run FP16 or bfloat16 to avoid any edge-case degradation. Keep classification/eval in FP16.
  - Quality validation: run a 200-item prompt set (we can provide) to compare FP16 vs INT8 outputs; expected ROUGE/EM delta < 1–2%.

2) Caching & batching:
  - KV prefix caching: enable for recurrent chat sessions (we’ve seen 20–35% token cost reduction for prefix-heavy flows).
  - Dynamic batch sizing: prioritize latency SLOs for chat; for off-peak batch jobs we’ll increase batch size to improve throughput.

3) Pilot scope & timeline:
  - Pilot length: 2 weeks of active evaluation (we’ll set objective metrics).
  - Pilot credits: Redwood proposes $12k in platform credits to offset integration work + 1 technical onboarding call with our inference team.
  - Success criteria (example): achieve >= 40% token-cost reduction on chat paths while maintaining p95 < 300ms and quality delta within agreed threshold.

4) Commercials & next steps:
  - Post-pilot: if success criteria met, we’ll put together a 6-month reserved band proposal with stepped discounts and an ops runbook.
  - Procurement items: standard MSA + SOW + SOC2 evidence; indicate if you need custom KMS/HSM integration on day 1.

Attachments (stubs): optimizer_playbook_v2.pdf (pilot playbook + eval checklist), Horizon_SOW_draft.docx (SOW draft).

Let me know a couple of preferred dates/times for the onboarding call next week — we can include our infra engineer to walk through token accounting and KV cache toggles.

Best,
Aditya Rao
